<thought>Using the observed protonated ion at m/z 114.06808, subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ~113.0608 Da. The formula C₆H₉O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 113.060255 Da, which matches the measured mass within experimental error, and yields an integer DBE. Therefore the molecular formula is C6H9O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
